name: Kevin Augusto Vieira
summary: Staff Product Manager with over 8 years of experience building 0-to-1 digital products, CRM automations, and AI-first workflows. Experienced in partnering with engineering leads to architect databases (Supabase, MySQL) and orchestrators (n8n). Academic background in Philosophy directly supports ethical AI system deployment, mitigating gender/race biases and guarding data confidentiality. Comfortable under strict regulatory guidelines (LGPD/GDPR), WhatsApp API rules, and Meta quality standards, combining compliance with Power BI analytics and continuous discovery.

bullets: AI Implementation & CRM Integration: Led the deployment of Meta's native CRM AI tool for 150+ consultants, creating structured prompt libraries in Claude under strict data compliance.
Performance & CRO Analytics: Partnered with MIS to leverage Power BI dashboards, translating complex operational data into strategic GTM adjustments.

Security & Compliance Governance (Wipro/Meta): Contributed to the BCP (Business Continuity Plan) design and drafted data governance manuals under strict sharing restrictions. Trained extensively in policy compliance and info security (phishing, social engineering, tailgating).

0-to-1 MVP Launch: Conceptualized and launched the 'Meu Barzin Pass' MVP (recurring subscription ecosystem integrated directly with WhatsApp Business API), validating monetization and B2B partner commercial feasibility.

Conversational Product Architecture: Architected product flows and UX logic via ManyChat, n8n, and Supabase databases over a VPS, setting 'Zero Hallucination' prompts to eliminate AI errors during venue lookups.

Metrics & LGPD Compliance: Acquired 505 leads with 22.3% deep funnel engagement. Mapped funnel drop-offs (43.9% first-message drop due to API latency) and designed opt-in flows in strict compliance with LGPD (data protection laws) and WhatsApp Business Platform policies.

UX/UI & Web Development (LGPD Compliance): Led end-to-end UX/UI Design and Web Development (WordPress, Elementor) for high-converting portals. Built technical compliance models, writing privacy policies, terms of use, and cookie consent systems.
CRO & A/B Testing: Designed and executed structured A/B tests on landing page headers (hero copy) and CTA buttons, leveraging organic SEO roadmaps to optimize visitor-to-lead conversion rates.
CRM & Workflow Automation: Integrated Bitrix24 and Sendpulse CRMs via API webhooks to automate lead nurturing and follow-up flows, optimizing pipeline velocity and tracking revenue metadata.
Strategic Communication: Crafted persuasive marketing copy and brand positioning narratives utilizing the global Thinking Environment human facilitation framework.
